name: vade-launcher
description: Club PC launcher: admin dashboard + client agent for night maintenance, Steam updates and power control

scripts.build: npm run build:agent && npm run build:admin
scripts.dist: npm run build:agent && npm run dist -w @vade/admin
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/protocol --noEmit && tsc -p apps/agent --noEmit && tsc -p apps/admin --noEmit
